title: Higher-order regularity for a structurally damped plate equation on rough domains
summary: We prove well-posedness and higher-order regularity for a linear structurally damped plate equation with inhomogeneous Dirichlet--Neumann boundary conditions on the half-space and on bounded domains. To this end, we study maximal regularity properties of the related first-order system on weighted Sobolev spaces of arbitrarily high smoothness. In particular, we consider Sobolev spaces with power weights that measure the distance to the boundary.
